text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not even here... 
It's still nowhere near enough... 
greenery, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
There's training tomorrow, too... 
Going into the mountains right now is out 
of the question... right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Could I perhaps 
set up camp right here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to fatigue, Daring Tact seems 
to yearn for nature 
even more than usual. 
It might be best to reconsider her 
upcoming schedule.
